maps.description: A slow river down the middle, two fords and a mill town on the bank.
maps.name: Orel Valley

maps.description: A river between the sides with three fords, all of them in range of the other bank.
maps.name: The Narew Line

maps.description: Where two rivers meet: a fight for the tongue of land between them.
maps.name: Two Waters

maps.description: Lakes and narrow land between them; every causeway matters.
maps.name: Masurian Lakes

maps.description: A market town where two roads cross, open fields all round.
maps.name: Kursk Crossroads

maps.description: High ground across the middle, crossed at passes.
maps.name: Point 112

maps.description: Shallow pools men can wade and causeway roads for the tanks.
maps.name: Pripet Marshes

maps.description: A great frozen lake in the middle: fight round it.
maps.name: Lake Ilmen

maps.description: Open steppe cut by dry gullies: tank country.
maps.name: Kalmyk Steppe

maps.description: Deep forest, few roads, close fighting.
maps.name: Hürtgen

maps.description: Rolling hills and wooded valleys in the snow.
maps.name: Ardennes Heights

maps.description: Two rivers and a ruined industrial town between them.
maps.name: Rhine and Ruhr
